verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships entirely as open-source skills/plugin files (GitHub repo) that install and run locally inside the user's own agent harness with no cloud backend — verified by a real keyless local install probe and docs stating the harness's own install mechanism is used and user files are never edited outside git. This effectively satisfies self-hosting since there is no separate hosted service to depend on. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation framing this as a 'self-hosted' deployment option, and no discussion of enterprise/offline self-hosting guarantees beyond default local install.
